_comment: Extraction golden set for the browser sidecar. Each case fetches a live public page through the sidecar and asserts a floor on extracted text — a regression guard for the extraction path (htmlmd suppression, frame traversal, settle timing). Network-dependent, so this is a MANUAL live probe (npm run bench), not a CI gate. minChars is deliberately conservative so normal page edits don't flip it; a case dropping to ~0 is the signal (e.g. an iframe-wrapped page losing frame traversal). Add representative Korean surfaces here as new failure modes are found.

cases.name: blog.naver desktop (iframe body — frame-traversal regression guard)
